One motion, six influences

Attraction pulls toward the amber target. Vortex adds sideways motion. Separation keeps agents apart, while avoidance steers around obstacles.

Wind pushes everything sideways. Damping removes speed. Try setting vortex to zero, then turn it up.

F = attraction + vortex + separation + avoidance + wind
v ← (v + F · dt) · exp(−damping · dt)

Field arrows show the shared forces. Agent-to-agent separation and velocity damping are not shown in these arrows.
